title: Finite exceptional restriction assertion
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, $n\ge1$, $f:X\to Y$ quasi-compact and $c$ a compactification. Define the assertion $\operatorname{Conclusion}(\ell,E,n,f,c)$ by quantifying over every ordinary-etale right adjoint $G$ of the compact-support functor for $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ and its supplied adjunction. It requires nonempty restriction data on the intrinsic finite-Tor constructible full subcategories: preservation by both functors, the restricted adjunction and its original class-relative Hom bijections, unit and counit, and comparisons for every compactification with identity and cocycle equations. These are properties of the specified functors and maps; this definition asserts neither their existence nor the conclusion. The constituent notions are [def-weil-compactifications-refinements] [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility] [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude] [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism] [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed] [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image].
